primitives.name: Vitest Worktree Isolation
primitives.verbatim_quote: Empirically challenge Vitest test runner isolation: - Try various invocation patterns, paths, and filters from root (`npx vitest list`, `npx vitest run --root`, etc.) to see if `.worktrees/**` can leak into test execution.
primitives.latex: \text{Isolate } T_i \in \mathcal{T} \text{ such that } P(\exists j \neq i : T_i \cap T_j \neq \emptyset | \text{invocation}) < \epsilon
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T_i': 'Set of test cases for worktree i (dimensionless)', '\\mathcal{T}': 'Collection of all worktrees (dimensionless)', 'j': 'Index of alternative worktree (dimensionless)', '\\epsilon': 'Maximum acceptable leakage probability (dimensionless)', 'P': 'Probability measure (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Independent worktree state, deterministic Vitest invocation, no environmental variable interference.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When .worktrees/** paths are globally expanded instead of per-worktree scope.
